limitations.note: The square-wave counter still runs through 20, producing a 21-clock period instead of the expected 20-clock period with 10 clocks high and 10 clocks low.

The rewrite forces the output low on entry to square mode instead of holding the previous sample until the next scheduled transition, and it changes the triangle's first post-reset step from a decrement to an increment.
The test treats the faulty 21-clock square period as correct, so it passes with the off-by-one bug still present.
